name: ARCAS Short (NASA TN D-4013/D-4014 half-scale tunnel model, Config 1)
_notes: Geometry of the ARCAS tunnel model in NASA TN D-4013 and TN D-4014, the reports its anchors are read from (see the series sources in anchors.json). d = 2.250 in = 0.05715 m.
Fins physically sit over the boattail station; modeled flush with the body tube aft end (the RASAero equal-volume convention region). Kernel cannot place fins on a transition.
Tip chord: the research doc gives two values (1.568 in 'tip-region chord' vs 2.09 in per the D-4013 figure); this fixture uses 2.09 in = 0.93 d, matching the drawn planform.
Boattail modeled from its dimensioned values (length 1.81 in, base dia 1.470 in); the nominal '15 deg half-angle' label is inconsistent with those (reflexed base lip ignored, as RASAero did).
Fin section is a double wedge (1.47 deg half-angle, LE radius 0.030 in); closest kernel cross-section is 'airfoil' - a known fidelity gap until feature #4 (8 airfoils).
Finish: polished (machined tunnel model, boundary-layer trips = fully turbulent, not roughness-limited).
Thicknesses are nominal: mass does not affect CP/CD scoring.
